task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: First navigate the robot to the FRONT_CRATE obstacle, pick it up, then navigate to the TEMP_ZONE to place it, then navigate to MEDICINE_BOTTLE, pick it up, navigate to MEDICAL_TABLE, and place the bottle on the table.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of the robot that needs to be removed.
TEMP_ZONE is a valid location to temporarily place the crate.
The robot's holding capacity is one object at a time.
All distances and interactions are within the robot's interaction_distance.
